title: Count Inversions
description:
Write a function that counts the number of inversions in an array. An inversion is a pair (i, j) where i < j but arr[i] > arr[j].

Example:
- Input: [2, 4, 1, 3, 5] → Output: 3 (pairs: (2,1), (4,1), (4,3))
- Input: [1, 2, 3] → Output: 0 (already sorted)
- Input: [3, 2, 1] → Output: 3 (every pair is inverted)
hints: The brute force approach: check every pair (i, j) where i < j.
Count the pair as an inversion if arr[i] > arr[j].
